content.text: {"core": "Change ends what has completed. In Breakthrough, it operates on the structure a sudden rupture has already cracked: a form whose load-bearing function has failed. Unacknowledged, the ending runs without recognition, so the cracked structure is treated as sound and takes weight it can no longer hold. Collapse arrives as surprise.", "sheetLine": "The break already happened; the structure is still being asked to carry."}
